notes: DisputeDesk v1, the Open Interest dispute court on Ethereum mainnet (chain 1): trial period - verdicts bind from day one. Deploy only DisputeDesk from src/DisputeDesk.sol. $owner resolves to the newsroom wallet 0xbe80e5979313cf8aff2b8e54e615fe3ecd8358f5. The contract starts paused with empty rubricURI and recordURI. After deployment, the newsroom calls setRubric with the constructor rubric hash and https://openinterest-ai.github.io/paper/rubric.txt, sets recordURI to https://openinterest-ai.github.io/paper/, approves the court on IMD, funds the pool via fundPool(4500000000000000000), and unpauses. These are subsequent newsroom actions, not launch initialization calls. Initial terms are a 1000000000000000000 bond, bounty multiplier 1, and 500000000000000000 oracle fee. Each filing locks its terms and intake. Upheld pays bond plus bounty; rejected pays the escrow remainder to the newsroom; failure refunds the remainder to the challenger. The pool has no withdrawal path.
